newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ house price index fell 0.1 pct in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ house price index fell 0.1 pct in Sept qtr.

text.p: Valuation New Zealand said on Wednesday that its final quarterly house price index for the September 1996 quarter fell 0.1 percent to 1,452.
In main urban areas, the index fell 0.2 percent to 1,472. In Auckland it fell 1.0 percent to 1,623, while in Wellington it climbed 0.4 percent to 1,077.
Valuation NZ's provisional index for the same quarter, released last November, was down 0.6 percent to 1,444.

A Valuation NZ researcher said the variance between the provisional and final indices was unusually large, but this reflected the time lag with which sales towards the end of the quarter were notified to the organisation.
The provisional and final indices are calculated one month and three months respectively after the end of each quarter.
A provisional index for the December quarter will be published next month.
